{{Top|leg}}
'''Triundel''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While commenting on the entry for [[Type A pulse-wave rifle]], Triundel mentioned that they had an interesting use as a hunting weapon since they made a satisfying sound when fired.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
